entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: A planeswalker who cannot remember his name, past or family and calls himself Yanggu after the first place he remembers.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels with Yanggu.

entities.name: The Easternmost Valley
entities.description: The first place Yanggu can remember, after which he named himself.

events.summary: Yanggu names himself after the Easternmost Valley, the first place he remembers.
events.quote: He decided to call himself Yanggu, meaning “the valley where sun rises,” after the first place he can remember

events.summary: Yanggu travels with Mu Yanling and the hound Mowu, searching for his past memories.
events.quote: He travels alongside the Planeswalker Mu Yanling and his loyal hound, Mowu, searching for his past memories.

relations.quote: He travels alongside the Planeswalker Mu Yanling
